about: What the scanner can and cannot judge, for every WCAG 2.1 A and AA criterion in each format. checked_in_part: a check exists and the note says what a person still judges. not_checked: applies to every file; the tool does not look. if_present: applies only when the file has the content named in 'when'. 'who' names who can close the gap: author, expert, or user_test (a person with assistive technology and a named task). Nothing here is ever reported as passed.
